source_lineage.mechanical_source: Classic arcade maze-chase structure generalized into seeded roguelike floors.
source_lineage.theme_source: Fleshpunk-style martial anatomy: body choices, infection pressure, route memory, mutation costs.
rights_boundary: Do not copy Pac-Man names, maze layouts, colors, sprites, sound identities, or ghost identities.
Do not copy Fleshpunk's named characters, rooms, prose, or lore; use only generalized body-pressure concepts.

theme_pitch.player_role: A white blood cell forced through damaged tissue channels during a spreading infection.
theme_pitch.required_collectibles: Antibodies deposited along capillary corridors; collecting them tags tissue as defended and advances floor clearance.
theme_pitch.reversal_pickups: Complement bursts: brief immune-overdrive windows where infection agents can be engulfed and digested.
theme_pitch.bonus_item: Memory antigen: a risky optional pickup that improves future recognition but teaches the infection one counter-pattern.
theme_pitch.exit_condition: Tag all required antibody sites, then reach the lymph gate before tissue fever peaks.
theme_pitch.tone: Fleshpunk-esque but systems-forward: slick tissue, damaged membranes, readable immune tactics, and body costs.

core_loop: Enter a seeded tissue maze with one infection strain profile and one tissue condition.
Collect antibodies to mark every required defense site while infection agents hunt by heat, scent, route memory, and tissue damage.
Use complement bursts to briefly reverse contact rules and consume infection agents for tempo, score, or route repair.
Choose whether to grab memory antigens, enter inflamed greed pockets, or preserve a clean route through the tissue.
Clear the antibody network, pass the lymph gate, and choose one body adaptation before the next tissue floor.
Later floors react to repeated habits: overuse complement, leave scar trails, ignore memory antigens, or rely on one adaptation.

movement_model.style: Simultaneous tick-grid movement with buffered turns at membrane junctions.
movement_model.why: Keeps arcade urgency while making infection pursuit deterministic and debuggable.
movement_model.contact_rule: Normal contact infects or kills the cell; complement-overdrive contact digests the infection agent and sends it to a rearm niche.
movement_model.route_readability: Every infection has a visible target-tile debug marker in dev mode and a player-facing body tell in normal play.

maze_generation.floor_unit: A tissue cross-section: capillary lanes, membrane walls, lymph gate, necrotic pockets, and rearm niches.
maze_generation.strategy: Seeded chunk assembly over pure random carving: central infection reservoir, loop corridors, antibody routes, optional necrotic pockets, and gate shortcuts.
required_checks: Every required antibody is reachable from spawn and exit.
At least two loops surround the infection reservoir.
Complement bursts are reachable before the earliest unavoidable contact.
No required antibody sits in an unmarked lethal dead end.
Memory antigen route has one viable ignore route and one viable greed route.

infection_agents.target_rule: Shortest path to current cell tile.
infection_agents.body_tell: Contracts into a needle posture before straight pursuit.

infection_agents.target_rule: Targets four tiles ahead of the cell's current direction.
infection_agents.body_tell: Extends a pale filament toward the next junction it wants to own.
mutation_examples: guards complement nodes after floor three

infection_agents.target_rule: Targets recently repeated turns and high-value antibody clusters.
infection_agents.body_tell: Leaves a faint stain on junctions it has learned.

infection_agents.target_rule: Alternates chase, scatter, and fever drift on a visible timer.
infection_agents.body_tell: Pulses with the floor fever meter before changing mode.
mutation_examples: creates a two-tick delayed fever echo

body_adaptations.effect: Pass through one narrow capillary shortcut per floor.
body_adaptations.route_cost: Lower impact margin; contact grace is disabled while squeezing.
body_adaptations.fleshpunk_rule: Solves entry and escape, not combat.

body_adaptations.effect: Complement windows are shorter, but the first digested infection leaves a speed wake.
body_adaptations.route_cost: Overuse raises infection recognition on later floors.
body_adaptations.fleshpunk_rule: Strong first commitment must create recovery trouble.

body_adaptations.effect: Clear a floor without memory antigen or complement overuse to reduce future fever.
body_adaptations.route_cost: Fewer shortcuts and lower score, but less route memory for infection.
body_adaptations.fleshpunk_rule: Pure-body discipline is a real progression path, not no-upgrade.

body_adaptations.effect: Drop a decoy immune marker that redirects one infection at a junction.
body_adaptations.route_cost: Repeated use teaches plasmid_flank to read false markers.
body_adaptations.fleshpunk_rule: A lie to body readers should work, then become a remembered risk.

body_adaptations.effect: Seal one damaged tile into temporary safe tissue.
body_adaptations.route_cost: The sealed scar becomes a future path preference for direct hunters.
body_adaptations.fleshpunk_rule: Treat wounds as locks and routes, not just health loss.

floor_modifiers.effect: Fever meter accelerates infection mode swaps as the floor timer runs.
floor_modifiers.tactical_question: Can the player finish the antibody route before pursuit becomes unstable?

floor_modifiers.effect: Optional antibody clusters sit in slow pockets that increase score and adaptation currency.
floor_modifiers.tactical_question: Is route greed worth leaving slower tissue behind?

floor_modifiers.effect: One infection agent starts with a counter to the adaptation used most last floor.
floor_modifiers.tactical_question: Can the player vary body identity instead of forcing one solution?

floor_modifiers.effect: Some walls open after complement use, creating shortcuts and new infection routes.
floor_modifiers.tactical_question: Does reversal also make the maze more dangerous?

scoring_and_pressure.memory_antigen: Optional run-memory currency; improves future strain preview but increases infection adaptation.
scoring_and_pressure.complement_chain: Digesting multiple infection agents in one burst gives high score and raises recognition debt.
scoring_and_pressure.clean_route_bonus: Clear without repeated loops or overdrive spam to reduce next-floor fever.
scoring_and_pressure.body_drift: Tracks repeated adaptation habits; later strains learn or misread the body accordingly.

debug_and_validation: Show each infection agent mode, target tile, next junction, and rearm timer.
Show antibody reachability count after generation.
Record floor seed, body adaptations, and infection strain profile for replay.
Flag any required antibody inside an unmarked dead end.
Simulate 20 seconds of idle pursuit to detect unavoidable spawn kills.

implementation_recommendation.prototype_engine: Browser canvas first for fast maze iteration, or Godot 4 if touch/mobile feel is the immediate target.
data_driven: infection agent target rules and mutation tables
body adaptation effects and recognition debt
tile type passability and speed costs
implementation_recommendation.first_milestone: One seeded tissue floor with antibodies, four infection agents, complement bursts, fever meter, and debug overlay.

art_style_direction.summary: Fleshpunk-detail organic maze icon: a blobby white blood cell with a circular engulfing silhouette.
player_silhouette: Round or oval leukocyte body readable at maze scale.
Open asymmetric membrane cleft that suggests engulfing without copying a geometric arcade wedge.
Uneven pseudopod rim, cilia, membrane folds, and amber nucleus glow.
Dense painterly bone/chitin/tissue detail visible in closeups, simplified to a pale round body in gameplay.
do_not_copy: licensed arcade colors, proportions, maze layout, or animation rhythm
